nodes.title: Create systems with a modal form and list saved systems
nodes.summary: Let the user start a new system by clicking a button that opens a modal form. The form requires a system name and has a save button that stores the system in IndexedDB. Saved systems are displayed in a list on the main page, and clicking one navigates to its system detail page. Covers the system creation, listing and navigation parts of [fb_e17aba8d-f3c5-4373-85ea-30f880c61bf6].

nodes.title: Generate copyable AI prompt for a project
nodes.summary: Add a button that generates a prompt the user can copy and paste into an AI. The prompt is made of three parts: the instruction asking the AI to produce a detailed document describing the project, the project context (the zip or the GitHub link), and the required JSON schema the AI response must follow. Includes a copy-to-clipboard action. Covers the prompt generation part of [fb_e17aba8d-f3c5-4373-85ea-30f880c61bf6].
